options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Tricky Jumps
options.doc: When enabled, some jumps and movement techniques that are much more difficult than usual may be considered in logic. See documentation for more information.

options.name: No Lantern
options.doc: When enabled, you may be expected to navigate dark areas without the lantern.

options.name: Damage Boosting
options.doc: When enabled, you may be expected to damage boost to an extent that will be possible in casual mode with health drops. When disabled, you can collect everything logically without taking damage.

options.name: Level Order
options.doc:
Determines which levels are unlocked with beacons. Each beacon will still unlock the same number of levels.
Vanilla: Each beacon will unlock its normal levels. Note that beacon locations may still be shuffled to random locations with Shuffle Beacons.
Faramore_Start_Shuffle: Each beacon will unlock 2 or 3 random levels, but Faramore Town is guaranteed to be one of your 2 starting levels to grant access to the shop.
Shuffle: Each beacon will unlock 2 or 3 random levels. Be careful that activating this might lock the store away for a while, and force the player to farm bags to get power stones.
Using Level Order = Faramore_Start_Shuffle or Shuffle without enabling Shuffle Beacons will make it hard to get a successful generation.

options.name: Shuffle Keys
options.doc:
Include all keys in the item and location pools.
This does not include quest items like the Fort Findula Dungeon Key.
This does also not include the Key in Lichen Hills' Music Shrine.

options.name: Shuffle Hills Key
options.doc:
Add the Lichen Hills key and its Music Shrine location to the pool.
If spawned in your local game, this key is invisible until the Fatal Flute is played near it, making it difficult to find otherwise.
One would need to know every location check in the game, and play the Flute next to them if they are empty.
The only other empty location would be the Shield Ring if you already collected the Reflecting Ring.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoutez la clé Lichen Hills et son emplacement de sanctuaire musical à la piscine.
Si frayé dans votre jeu local, cette clé est invisible jusqu'à ce que la Flûte Fatale soit jouée près d'elle, ce qui rend difficile de trouver autrement.
Il faudrait savoir chaque emplacement vérifier dans le jeu, et jouer la Flûte à côté d'eux s'ils sont vides.
Le seul autre endroit vide serait l'anneau de bouclier si vous avez déjà recueilli l'anneau réfléchissant.

options.name: Shuffle Bags
options.doc: Include bags in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Candles
options.doc: Include all candles in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Coins
options.doc: Include all secret coins in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Upgrades
options.doc: Include all the capacity upgrades in the item and location pools. This includes Infinite Soulfire.

options.name: Shuffle Rocks
options.doc: Include all four colored rocks in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Plants
options.doc: Include all three of the Cypress' quest's plants in the item and location poolsl.

options.name: Shuffle Life-Ups
options.doc: Include all Life-Ups (extra hearts) in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Bonus Scroll Rewards
options.doc:
Include the Rubies rewards from the bonus minigame scrolls in the item and location pools.
Note that Faramore, Volcano and Castle Bonus do not have any rewards.

options.name: Shuffle Race Rewards
options.doc: Include the 100 Rubies rewards from the Rudy races in the item and location pools.

options.name: Shuffle Beacons
options.doc:
Include the Sacred Beacons in the item and location pools.
Sacred Beacons will stay in your local game, cannot spawn from other items, and will still unlock levels when hit.
Not to be confused with Level Order, which decides which level is unlocked by hitting the beacon.

options.name: Shuffle Jewel Shards
options.doc: Include the Faramore Jewel shards in the item and location pools. Beating the five bosses will now grant random items.

options.name: Shuffle NPCs
options.doc: Include NPCs in the item and location pools. NPCs will stay in your local game.

options.name: Shuffle Bonus Scrolls
options.doc:
Include Bonus Scrolls in the item and location pools.
Bonus Scrolls will stay in your local game, and cannot spawn from other items.

options.name: Shuffle Barrier Types
options.doc:
When enabled, will randomize the barrier types. All barriers of a certain type will be changed to another.
If enabled, then Shuffle Coins or Tricky Jumps needs to be enabled as well, or else the Crypts Coin would be unreachable.

options.name: Trading Sequence
options.doc:
Determine how the Chainsword trading sequence is randomized:
Vanilla: All items except the Dungeon Key will be in their vanilla locations, including the Chainsword. In other words, talking to Alven once will give you random item. Finding the Fort Findula Dungeon Key will kickstart the trading sequence, which will always lead to the Chainsword in the end.
Random_Start: One random item of the trading sequence will be shuffled, and the rest of the sequence from that item will be in their vanilla locations, including the Chainsword. The start of the trade quest will be avoided entirely, including Zazie's Soul Upgrade if it doesn't start with the Sacred Oil.
Excluded: The Dungeon Key, the Sacred Oil & Refined Chains, and the Chainsword items will be shuffled, as well as the locations for the Dungeon Key, the Sacred Oil and the Chainsword. The rest of the trade quest will be avoided entirely, including Zazie's Soul Upgrade. In other words, talking to Alven once will give you random item, talking to Alven with the Sacred Oil and Refined Chains will give you a random item, and going to the end of the Fort Findula Dungeon will give you a random item. Every other NPC interaction in the sequence will ask for an item that you cannot obtain.
Shuffle: Every item in the Chainsword trading sequence is added to the item and location pools. The game has been modified so you can hold multiple items of the trading sequence at the same time, but they might not show up in the inventory.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer comment la séquence de trading Chainsword est randomisée :
Vanilla: Tous les articles sauf la clé Dungeon seront dans leurs emplacements de vanille, y compris la Chainsword. En d'autres termes, parler à Alven une fois vous donnera un élément aléatoire. Trouver la clé de donjon Fort Findula va lancer la séquence de trading, ce qui conduira toujours à la Chainsword à la fin.
Random_Start: Un élément aléatoire de la séquence de trading sera mélangé, et le reste de la séquence de cet élément sera dans leurs emplacements de vanille, y compris le Chainsword. Le début de la quête commerciale sera entièrement évité, y compris la mise à niveau de l'âme de Zazie si elle ne commence pas avec l'huile sacrée.
Excluded: La clé de donjon, l'huile sacrée et les chaînes raffinées, et les éléments du mot chaîne seront mélangés, ainsi que les emplacements pour la clé de donjon, l'huile sacrée et le mot chaîne. Le reste de la quête commerciale sera entièrement évité, y compris l'amélioration de l'âme de Zazie. En d'autres termes, parler à Alven une fois vous donnera un élément aléatoire, parler à Alven avec l'huile sacrée et les chaînes raffinées vous donnera un élément aléatoire, et aller à la fin du donjon de Fort Findula vous donnera un élément aléatoire. Chaque autre interaction NPC dans la séquence demandera un élément que vous ne pouvez pas obtenir.
Shuffle: Chaque élément de la séquence de trading Chainsword est ajouté aux pools d'éléments et de localisation. Le jeu a été modifié de sorte que vous pouvez tenir plusieurs éléments de la séquence de trading en même temps, mais ils pourraient ne pas apparaître dans l'inventaire.
